verdict.summary: Analysing remains a strong pre-RC component with mature Symfony-oriented architecture and extensive established QA evidence, but the current candidate is not release-immutable: the RC branch is dirty, three commits ahead of upstream, has a staged deletion of a previously verified domain-hygiene guard, and contains unresolved Gating packaging duplication. Current composer validation is GREEN, while the reused managed PHP server still returns 404 for /status through its production-style router; the repository documents this routing artifact and uses a dedicated Playwright QA router for behavioral verification.
strengths: Symfony 8.1/PHP 8.4 component with Doctrine persistence, explicit routes, migrations, and established RC verification history.
PHPStan max, PHPUnit, coverage, Gating, schema parity, and Playwright behavioral tooling are materially evidenced by repository configuration and prior journaled verification.
Existing managed runtime was reused rather than restarted.
The /status route and dedicated Playwright routing workaround are explicitly present in the repository.
risks: Working tree has six dirty paths and therefore is not an immutable RC candidate.
tools/analytics-domain-hygiene-guard.php is staged for deletion despite prior verification history treating that guard as part of local canonical enforcement.
composer.json currently contains two equivalent ../Gating path repository entries.
.gating/README.md is being expanded into normative Gating documentation even though the repository journal and its own text define consumer .gating as an artifact surface.

The existing managed PHP server returns 404 for /status when routed directly through public/index.php; behavioral health through the repository's Playwright router was not re-executed under READ_ONLY authority.
Inter-component dependencies remain dev-master based and the current HEAD has no exact release tag.
next_actions: Reconcile the staged domain-hygiene guard deletion with equivalent canonical Gating coverage before accepting the candidate.
Remove or otherwise intentionally resolve the duplicate Gating path repository declaration.
Reconcile consumer .gating artifact ownership so normative Gating documentation does not drift into the generated artifact surface.
Bring the working tree to an intentional clean candidate and rerun the established deterministic quality stack.
Run the existing Playwright /status behavioral check on the exact clean candidate using its repository-owned QA router.
After green verification, synchronize the RC branch and create an exact release tag according to release policy.
